However, when I actually returned the skirt, an additional ₹50 was deducted under the name of “return fee.” My concern is not simply about the amount, but about the lack of transparency. If a return fee is applicable, it should be clearly disclosed to the customer before the order is placed, not introduced at the time of return. After this experience, I have decided that I will no longer purchase anything from Myntra, nor will I recommend Myntra to anyone.
